title: What happens to your brain when you stop scrolling for 7 days?

scenes.text: What happens to your brain when you stop scrolling for seven days?
Day one feels strange. Your thumb reaches for the phone on its own, because checking has become a habit.
In studies where people cut back on social media, many reported small improvements in mood.
And suddenly you have hours you didn't know you had.
Seven days won't rewire you, but it shows you how often you reached.
So what happens when you stop scrolling? You finally notice.
